title: Projects
subtitle: Cloned repos and uploaded folders · one worktree per active task.

modal.title: New project
modal.name: Name
modal.repo_access_hint: secrets live on the credentials page, never on the project
modal.description_hint: short blurb the agent reads at init
modal.description_placeholder: Public website (Next.js). Marketing copy, landing pages, A/B tests.
modal.default_board_hint: Where this project's tasks start when the API or an agent creates them without naming a board. A task created from the board starts on the board that is open.

auth.app_info: Repositories the App installation grants. Picking one fills the URL below and links the project to the installation — tokens are minted per operation and nothing long-lived is stored.
auth.install_hint: Install the App on your org to pick repos without tokens.
auth.token_info_html: Validated against api.github.com and stored on the credentials page, where it can be rotated, disabled or granted to other projects. Classic tokens need repo, plus workflow to dispatch Actions.

toasts.token_rejected: GitHub rejected that token — it was saved, but it will not clone
toasts.install_requested: Install requested — waiting for your GitHub org admin to approve
toasts.read_failed: Could not read the folder. Try Choose folder instead.
toasts.cloning: {name} is cloning; its card says when it is ready
toasts.link_task_failed: The project was created but could not be linked to the task: {error}

errors.pick_folder: Choose a folder or a .zip with the code
errors.too_big: The upload is {size}; the limit is {max}. Leave out build output or large assets and try again.
errors.pick_credential: Pick a credential or create one, or choose “Public repo”
errors.repo_required: The project needs the repository URL
errors.token_required: Paste the token the credential stores

confirm.delete_message: Removes the local clone and all worktrees. Tasks linked to it will lose their project.

github_reasons.state: the install link expired, was already used, or was opened in another browser; start again from Thulu
github_reasons.fetch: Thulu couldn't read the installation from GitHub
github_reasons.claimed: that installation is already connected to another workspace; ask the operator to move it
github_reasons.installer: your GitHub user can't see that installation
github_reasons.authorize: GitHub didn't send the authorization this install needs; the App must request user authorization during installation
github_reasons.unclaimed: the installation isn't connected to any workspace; install it from Thulu

source.git_desc: Clone from GitHub or another remote
source.upload_desc: From your computer, no GitHub needed

upload.drop_sub: or pick it from your computer. A .zip works too.
upload.rules: node_modules, .venv and other dependency folders stay out, and so do files that look like secrets (.env, private keys). With its .git the project keeps its history; without it, the folder is the first commit on main.
upload.nothing_left: No files left to upload once dependency folders and secrets are taken out.

excluded.one: {count} file left out as a possible secret
excluded.other: {count} files left out as possible secrets

upload.zip_note: Thulu sorts the zip's files when it arrives.
upload.created_fresh: New repository. The folder is the first commit on {branch} ({commit}).
upload.history_ignored: The .git in the upload had no commits, so the project starts a new history.
